title: 第四隻東風
subject: one of the last hand-carvers of mahjong tiles, in a narrow Jordan shopfront, spending three afternoons carving a single East Wind to replace the one a Yau Ma Tei table has gone without for years in a forty-year-old set his own master carved, copying the master's long-tailed stroke from the three surviving East tiles and steeping the too-white blank in pu'er until its yellow matches by eye in the doorway's afternoon sun
caption: Cantonese Delta blues, raw porch style, two acoustic guitars and a harmonica. A resonator guitar played with a glass bottleneck slide in open D tuning, a second acoustic guitar thumbing a steady alternating bass, a cross-harp harmonica bending long notes between lines, and a foot stomping on a wooden board as the only percussion. Dry, close, one-room recording with audible string noise and floor creak. A weathered male baritone in his sixties, unhurried and gravelly, half-speaking some lines and letting the slide answer each phrase. 76 BPM, D major. Wry, warm and patient. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no gospel choir, no rock band, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
佐敦 窄舖 一張枱 一盞燈
四十年嚟 我淨係識刻麻雀
佐敦 窄舖 一張枱 一盞燈呀
而家成條街 得返我一把刻刀

[Verse]
油麻地有張枱 副牌少咗隻東風
後備白板 箱頭筆寫個東 頂咗十幾年
啲墨一摸就甩 邊個手指頭黑咗
成枱人 都知佢手上有東

[Chorus]
東風 東風 唔使急
三個下晝 刻一隻
四十年嘅黃 冇色板對
我坐喺門口 靠對眼

[Verse]
阿娟姐 帶埋另外三隻東風嚟
一字排開 喺我枱面 好似等開飯
頭一日 磨個白胚 磨到同佢哋一樣厚
第二日 先落刀 一撇 一捺

[Chorus]
東風 東風 唔使急
四十年前 呢副 係我師傅刻嘅
佢個東字 尾巴拖長咗少少
我跟住佢 拖返一樣咁長

[Verse]
第三日 新胚太白 白到好似假牙
成晚浸喺 濃普洱度
企喺門口 對住西斜 比咗十幾次
差少少 我就再浸多陣

[Bridge]
阿娟姐嚟攞 四隻東風擺埋一行
佢拎起嚟 睇完又睇
估咗三次 都估唔到邊隻係新嘅

[Chorus]
東風 東風 唔使急
三個下晝 刻一隻
今晚油麻地 嗰張枱
終於夠晒 一百四十四隻

[Outro]
冇人再知 邊個手上有東
我收返把刻刀 又等下一隻
